map.闰年检查器依据格里高利历规则判断指定年份是否为闰年并说明原因，支持批量与区间查询: The leap year checker applies Gregorian calendar rules to judge whether a given year is a leap year and explains why, supporting batch and range queries, for calendar calculation, date logic validation and teaching demos.
map.判年份是否闰年。: Judge whether a year is a leap year.

map.：2024 被 4 整除且不被 100 → 闰年（366 天）；2100 被 1: : 2024 is divisible by 4 and not by 100 -> leap year (366 days); 2100 is divisible by 100 but not by 400 -> common year.
map.四年一闰、百年不闰、四百年再闰。: Leap every four years, not every hundred, but again every four hundred.
map.闰年的判定规则是什么？: What is the leap year rule?
map.能被 4 整除且不能被 100 整除，或能被 400 整除的年份为闰年，如 20: A year divisible by 4 but not by 100, or divisible by 400, is a leap year; for example 2024 is a leap year while 2100 is not.
